title: TStruct: Learning Shared Temporal Structures for Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.17864v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-term time series forecasting requires temporal dependency modeling that remains stable and generalizable under temporal distribution shifts. However, real-world time series are often noisy and non-stationary, making deep learning models prone to fitting incidental temporal interactions in the training data. A key question is whether there exist temporal relationship structures that recur across different temporal positions and variables. We analyze temporal relationship matrices on commonly used time series datasets and find that samples from different temporal positions and different variables exhibit shared dominant temporal relationship structures. This indicates that temporal relationship structures contain patterns that recur stably across samples and variables. translated_title: TStruct：学习共享时间结构用于长期时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 长期时间序列预测需要时间依赖建模在时间分布偏移下保持稳定且可泛化。然而，现实世界的时间序列往往存在噪声且非平稳，这使得深度学习模型容易拟合训练数据中的偶然性时间交互。一个关键问题是：是否存在在不同时间位置和不同变量之间重复出现的时间关系结构。我们分析了常用时间序列数据集上的时间关系矩阵，发现来自不同时间位置和不同变量的样本表现出共享的主导时间关系结构。这表明时间关系结构中包含在样本和变量之间稳定重复出现的模式。为了学习这种共享结构，我们提出了时间结构网络（TStruct），这是一个简单而有效的网络，用于直接学习共享……
tldr: 提出TStruct网络，通过学习跨时间位置和变量之间共享的时间关系结构，提升长期时间序列预测在时间分布偏移下的稳定性与泛化能力。
en_tdlr: TStruct is a simple yet effective network that learns shared temporal relationship structures across temporal positions and variables, improving the stability and generalization of long-term time-series forecasting under temporal distribution shifts.
